tasks.CheckDigits: Validate that the file name contains no more than three digits.
tasks.CheckDotPresence: Ensure there is exactly one dot in the file name.
tasks.CheckFileExtension: Confirm that the extension matches one of ['txt', 'exe', 'dll'].
tasks.CheckFileNameStartsWithLetter: Verify that the substring before the dot starts with a letter from the Latin alphabet.
tasks.FinalValidation: Return 'Yes' if all conditions are met, otherwise return 'No'.
tasks.ValidateFileName: Overall validation function to check file name against given rules.
